$comment: The corpus. scripts/seed.py records these against a running API; tests/unit/test_capabilities.py runs each one against capabilities/fixtures/<name>/ with no Docker. Every entry declares a strong verifier: an exit_code verifier is satisfied by any container that exits 0, which makes evidence forgeable.

goal.statement: Create a reproducible tar, tar.gz or zip archive with zeroed timestamps and ownership
Safely extract a zip or tar archive, refusing path traversal, absolute paths and link entries
Base64 encode or decode a file, standard or URL-safe alphabet
Business-day arithmetic with holidays and the observed-holiday rule: last business day of a month, the Nth, and N business days from a date
Generate a checksum manifest of every input file using sha256, sha1, sha512 or md5
Compute the next run times of a cron expression from a given instant
Remove duplicate rows from a CSV file, keyed on all columns or a chosen subset
Detect the delimiter, quoting, header and structural damage of a real-world CSV file
Infer a JSON Schema describing the rows of a CSV file
Select and rename CSV columns from a declarative spec
Convert a CSV file into a normalized JSON array of objects
Convert a CSV file into newline-delimited JSON, one object per line
Render a CSV file as a Markdown table
Validate the structure of a CSV file and report ragged rows, duplicate headers and invalid UTF-8
Parse dates and report day/month and century ambiguity explicitly instead of guessing
Convert a delimited text file between CSV, TSV, pipe and semicolon without corrupting quoted fields
Shift a local time across a daylight saving transition, separating wall-clock arithmetic from elapsed time
Detect the character encoding of a text file, reporting BOM, ambiguity and mixed-encoding damage
Convert an HTML document into Markdown, preserving headings, links, lists and code blocks
Convert an INI configuration file into JSON
Structurally diff two JSON documents and report added, removed and changed paths
Apply an RFC 7386 JSON Merge Patch to a JSON document
Pretty-print or minify a JSON document with sorted keys
Convert a JSON array of objects into a CSV file
Validate a JSON document against a JSON Schema and report errors
Convert newline-delimited JSON records into a CSV file
Decode a JSON Web Token's header and payload without verifying the signature
Normalise line endings to LF, CRLF or CR and strip a UTF-8 byte order mark
Repair mojibake: UTF-8 text that was decoded as cp1252 or latin-1 and saved again as UTF-8
Split a money amount into weighted shares that add back up to exactly the total, in the currency's own minor units
Parse money written in any locale into an exact decimal, reporting values whose thousands separator and decimal point cannot be told apart
Expand a recurring local appointment into the UTC instants it happens at across DST transitions
Extract every match of a regular expression from a text file
Settle an NWF-REMIT-V3 remittance advice from Northwind Freight into a cleared total
Produce a unified diff between two text files
Convert a TOML document into JSON
Convert an XML document into a structured JSON tree of tags, attributes and text
